basic_info.description: Waivers from the MOHCD BMR program are available!  140% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $146,850; 2 people = $167,850.  Do not have to be a First-Time Homebuyer! Homebuyer education can be completed after applying. 2-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 120% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $143,900; 3 = $161,800; 4 = $179,800, 5 = $194,200 etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. The unit will be available on a first come first served basis starting on 4/11/2025 at 8:00 AM PST.   Visit https://housing.sfgov.org/listings/a0W7y0000044L1xEAE for application & program info.   Fair Housing opportunity. Spacious 2 BR Goldmine Hill condo (1 bedroom + loft) with high ceilings and spectacular, unobstructed views of Downtown San Francisco and the East Bay. Located on the top floor of a beautifully landscaped Diamond Heights complex.
